name: mix709_G7_N8_mixB
input: two live stock sets: the cool set (4) and the warm set (5)
command: python -m epdlut.recipe mix709 SET4.bin SET5.bin OUT.bin
steps: W rows from set 4, K/Y/B rows from set 5
stretch the B phases x1.493 to the stock PLL-08 pulse widths
8 balanced S/K toggles before each changed-pixel track
pad, right-align, balance at both nominal and measured rails

expected.quality: set 5 median 0.60 / worst 1.64; set 4 median 0.74 / worst 1.67; 100 updates (stock every 10) largest rise +0.06

note: our builder output differs from the lab table in the prefix (830 vs 857 frames); verify before relying on it
